name: Biology PhD
detailsNote: Official information available; Fall 2027 dates not confirmed. Program describes both direct research admission and laboratory rotations, so a single admission model is not assigned.

publishedDeadlines.label: Fall admission
publishedDeadlines.note: Program page gives no year; no spring/summer admission.

english.note: TOEFL or IELTS Academic required for international applicants; numerical program minima not established on opened page.

applicationFee.note: Central listed-program participation waivers; eligibility verified. International eligibility not explicit; confirm. IBMS merit waivers are not applied to this separate Biology program.

requirements.note: Undergraduate or master's degree in biology, chemistry or related field. Department describes one integrated PhD replacing previous concentrations. Entry may be direct into research or through two eight-week rotations.

funding.note: Department offers competitive graduate assistantships including a stipend and tuition waiver, and advises early application. No all-admitted or separate international guarantee stated.
